```console
#!/bin/bash
# Copy the delivered paths of this repository into a clone of the delivery root: code/, results/ (+ prereg/ -> results/prereg/, data/ -> results/data/).
# usage: bash code/deliver.sh <delivery_clone_dir>
set -e
R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"; T=$1
rsync -a --delete --exclude '__pycache__' "$R/code/" "$T/code/"
rsync -a --delete --exclude '__pycache__' "$R/results/" "$T/results/"
mkdir -p "$T/results/prereg" "$T/results/data"
rsync -a "$R/prereg/" "$T/results/prereg/"; rsync -a "$R/data/" "$T/results/data/"
# Code: which benchmarks to run for a new model, and how many

Reproduces every number, table and figure input of the paper from the pinned MTEB results. Pre-registration: `../prereg/PREREG.md`
(append-only; deviations are listed at its end). Result files: `../results/`. Matrix (derived, small): `../data/`.
**Delivered tree (paper-repo):** `code/`, `results/`; the working repository's `prereg/` is `results/prereg/` and its `data/` is `results/data/` there (`code/deliver.sh` copies the mapping).

## Environment
CPU only. Python 3.11.2; numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pandas 3.0.6, pyarrow 26.0.0, scikit-learn 1.9.1, matplotlib 3.11.2, torch 2.14.1+cpu
(see `requirements.lock`; torch is used by no script that produces a reported number — all models are numpy/scipy). Step 2 additionally
needs `mteb==2.27.24` (task metadata only; no score is read from it). All BLAS work is single-threaded (`OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`) and
jobs are parallelised by (split, fold); results do not depend on the thread count. Global seed `20261126` (`common.SEED`); every
derived seed is a function of it, of the split/fold and of the model index (no use of Python's `hash`).

## Data
```
git clone https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/results mteb_results   # CC0-1.0, ~0.6 GB history
git -C mteb_results checkout 6dabbcc68c28ea5f180ce7df79347b3ca9cc6383
```
(raw results are not stored in this repository; `data/` holds the derived matrix: `matrix_long.parquet` (model, task, score, eval_time),
`models.csv` (org group, release date, run-set size), `tasks.csv` (task type, n_models), `coverage_filter.csv` (Table 1), `matrix_summary.json`.)

## Pipeline (W = scratch dir, D = `data/`, R = result dir of the stage-B parquet files, `results/` = delivered result files)
Times are wall-clock measured on the shared 4-CPU job containers (host load varied); `NP` = number of parallel processes (default 4).
| step | command | what it does | output | measured time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `python code/01_extract.py mteb_results/results $W` | flatten raw tree to cells | `$W/cells_raw.parquet`, `model_meta.parquet` | ~3 min |
| 2 | `python code/02_taskmeta.py $W` | task type/splits from `mteb` (metadata only) | `$W/task_meta.parquet` | ~1 min |
| 3 | `python code/03_build_matrix.py $W data` | rules R1–R7 of PREREG B: one revision per model, dedup, org groups, coverage filter | `data/*` (238 models x 328 tasks, 45,775 cells) | <1 min |
| 4 | `bash code/04_states.sh data $W` | stage A per fold: standardisation, factor-analysis fits for all ranks, inner group-CV rank choice per k, floors, margins | `$W/state/{G_0..G_9,T_0,S_0}.pkl` | 290 s (4 procs) |
| 5 | `python code/06_delta_table.py $W prereg/delta_by_fold.csv` | collects margins (committed before any contrast) | `prereg/delta_by_fold.csv` | <1 min |
| 6 | `bash code/22_ct_all.sh data $W $R/ct S0,S1,S2,S4,S6,S6T,S6c ct 50` | **primary stage B, common target set** (`21_eval_ct.py`), 50 shared C/T splits | `$R/ct/*_ct.parquet` | 216 s (4 procs) |
| 7 | `python code/24_aggregate_ct.py data $R/ct results ct` | curves, excess over floor, S6-vs-S0 contrast and verdicts, k*(eps), decomposition (group bootstrap B=5000) | `results/ct_*.csv`, `ct_run_meta.json` | 16 s |
| 8 | `bash code/22_ct_all.sh data $W $R/ctx S0,S6,S5,S6s,S3,S7,INF ctx 20` after `12_extra_all.sh` | baselines (S3, S5, S6s, S7) and pipelines P2–P4, P6 on the C/T score, 20 splits | `$R/ctx/*_ctx.parquet` (aggregate with step 7, tag `ctx`) |
[truncated for publication]

shown.message:
I delivered the uploader-grouping files to `paper-repo` `dev` in one push (1a3a870) and closed `experiment-repo`#9.

- **What went in:** `results/olb_uploader/`, `code/44_olb_uploader.sh`, the updated `results/COLUMNS.md`, and `results/prereg/PREREG.md` with Deviation 4(l). I ran `code/deliver.sh` for it. `PREREG.md` had not reached `dev` before.
- **README row for the step:** its output path was wrong, pointing at `results/olb/uploader_groups/`. It now says `results/olb_uploader/`, and it states how the data directory is prepared (the `org` column replaced by `up:<uploader>`). I did not run `code/44_olb_uploader.sh` again, so its commands are as they were when the job ran.
- **Coverage table:** the README line called it "Table 1". It now says "the coverage table of Appendix A". I didn't use a number, so it can't go stale if the numbering shifts. I did not check the paper's numbering myself; I took the reviewer's word that it is Table 2.
- **Also pushed to `experiment-repo` `main`:** the same README edit.

`internal-review-repo` said it will cut the next candidate and re-offer once this is on `dev`.
